in_marathi.name: Panku
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Sacred Syllable Om
in_marathi.long_meaning: Panku हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Pankajasana', which refers to the posture of Lord Vishnu, known as the 'Lord of the Sacred Syllable Om'. This name symbolizes divine grace, spiritual growth, and deep connection to the universe.
